title: Effect of arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) inoculation on crop yield
research_question: Does AMF inoculation increase crop yield compared to non-inoculated controls?

population.description: Field and greenhouse crops inoculated with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi

intervention.description: Inoculation with arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi (AMF) — any species of Glomeromycota

comparator.definition: Same crop without AMF inoculation; may receive sterilized inoculant carrier or mock inoculum

primary.description: Crop yield (grain yield, fruit yield, tuber yield, shoot/root biomass)

primary_outcomes: Crop yield (grain yield, shoot biomass, fruit yield, tuber yield)
important_moderators: AMF species (Glomus mosseae, Rhizophagus irregularis, etc.)
Inoculant type (single species, mixed species, commercial product)
extraction_priorities: 1. CRITICAL: Extract yield for BOTH AMF-inoculated AND non-inoculated control
2. Control = no AMF; Treatment = with AMF inoculation
3. If multiple AMF species tested, extract EACH vs same control separately
5. Record AMF species, host crop, and soil P status
6. Focus on YIELD outcomes, not colonization rates or root parameters
tc_confusion_warnings: Control is the NON-INOCULATED treatment (no AMF added)
Some papers test AMF + P fertilizer factorial designs — extract AMF vs no-AMF at same P level
Do NOT confuse ectomycorrhiza (ECM) with arbuscular mycorrhiza (AM/AMF)
Colonization percentage is NOT yield — exclude as primary outcome
Some papers report both pot and field results — extract separately with setting label

search.seed_papers_description: Wu et al. 2022 (PeerJ, meta-analysis of AMF inoculation on crop yield, 546 observations)

inclusion_criteria: Primary experiment comparing AMF-inoculated vs non-inoculated crops
Reports yield or biomass data (numeric means)
AMF inoculation is the experimental variable
Includes both inoculated treatment and non-inoculated control
exclusion_criteria: Only reports colonization, root traits, or nutrient uptake without yield
No control group (observational study of natural colonization)
Native AMF diversity study without inoculation treatment

published_pooled_effect.notes: +23% yield [16%, 30%] from AMF inoculation under RAINFED conditions. 76.2% of individual effects positive. Wheat +34%, chickpea +18%. N-fixing crops +29% vs non-N-fixing +20%. PeerJ fully OA. NOTE: rainfed-only scope.
